products.note: HR and finance AI; skills-based talent; predictive analytics; sensitive HR data exposure

profile_text.body:
Workday is a public company, traded as WDAY, founded in 2005 and headquartered in Pleasanton, California. Its site describes it as an enterprise AI platform for HR, finance, and IT, and promotes agentic AI and Sana. The company says its AI lets customers activate teams of specialized agents to perform key processes across HR, finance, and IT, and that these agents can find, build, act, and automate rather than only assist. The site frames the offering around faster return on investment, trust, agility, and data readiness.

The product tracked for Workday is Workday AI, described as HR and finance AI covering skills-based talent, predictive analytics, and sensitive HR data exposure.

Filings and court records add detail. Workday's SEC identifier is CIK 0001327811, and its most recent revenue filing is a 10-K reporting $9,552,000,000 for the period ending 2026-01-31. Federal district court cases naming Workday include Meckfessel Poletti v. Workday, Inc. in the Eastern District of California, Williams v. Workday, Inc. in the Northern District of Georgia, Elias v. Workday, Inc. in the Northern District of California, Noriega (PS) v. Workday, Inc. and Doe (PS) v. Workday, Inc. in the District of Colorado, and Hill v. Workday, Inc. in the District of Maryland and the Eastern District of Virginia. California is the state with the largest recorded litigation exposure, at 281 cases.
